capabilities: Render notes in a folder as timeline bars using frontmatter start and end date fields
Add a Timeline view type to Obsidian Bases with Base-managed filters, sorts, and grouping
Configure views via a Markdown config file or an in-view editing form
Display year, month, or day scales with hover, click, and keyboard navigation
Report invalid configs or notes missing or misordered dates without crashing
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states it is local-first with no network requests, telemetry, or remote code execution.
intentEvidence: add Timeline as a native Base view type alongside Table, Board, Calendar, and Gallery
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize a set of notes as bars on a time axis or Gantt chart.
summary: Timeline/Gantt view that plots notes in a folder or Obsidian Base onto a start/end date axis drawn from frontmatter fields.
